title: Transported functor and comparison package for exceptional transport
statement: For fixed operation and left-realization families, endpoint reconstructions, integral operations, and integral realizations, there exists the package of transported functors, adjunctions, reconstruction comparisons, and finite evaluation comparisons (all fields of TransportCorePostData except integralLeft).

proof.text: Conjugate the supplied integral F and G by the inverse endpoint reconstruction equivalences. Compose their adjunctions using realizedAdjunction. Cancel the two equivalence unit isomorphisms to obtain realizeF and realizeG; cancel the source unit to obtain reductionF and reductionG. These are explicit functor and isomorphism constructions.

Identify reconstruction followed by finite evaluation with actual scalar reduction, using evaluation_eq, reduction and reductionEvaluation. Whisker the integral left realization with quotient extension; apply the qcqs compact-support finite comparison and then the inverse finite left realization. Fully faithful finite inclusion lifts this ambient composite to the left evaluation comparison.

For the right functor use the one-field right finite-reduction comparison. Whisker both finite comparisons by the source inverse reconstruction, then cancel its counit using invFunIdAssoc. Assemble all nine fields. Neither the integral operation/realization choices nor a new choice of system functors is used.

theorem exists_exceptional_transport_post_functor_data
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (reconstruction : ∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l, ∀ side : Bool,
      Reconstruction l E (endpoint X Y side))
    (operations : ∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l,
      IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E.carrier)
    (realizations : ∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l,
      IntegralSystemRealization.Realizations l E.carrier D (operations E)) :
    Nonempty (TransportCorePostFunctorData l Ω D hl c operation left reconstruction
      operations realizations)
